title: God Is King over All the Earth

questions.question: Clap your hands, all peoples! Shout to God with loud songs of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 47:1 (ESV): "Clap your hands, all peoples! Shout to God with loud songs of joy!"

questions.question: For the Lord, the Most High, is to be feared, a great what over all the earth?
questions.explanation: Psalm 47:2 (ESV): "...a great king over all the earth."

questions.question: He subdued peoples under us, and nations under our what?
He chose our heritage for us, the pride of whom he loves?
questions.explanation: Psalm 47:4 (ESV): "...the pride of Jacob whom he loves."

questions.question: God has gone up with a shout, the Lord with the sound of a what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 47:5 (ESV): "God has gone up with a shout, the Lord with the sound of a trumpet."

questions.question: Sing praises to God, sing praises! Sing praises to our King, sing what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 47:6 (ESV): "Sing praises to God, sing praises! Sing praises to our King, sing praises!"

questions.question: For God is the King of all the earth; sing praises with a what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 47:7 (ESV): "For God is the King of all the earth; sing praises with a psalm!"

questions.question: God reigns over the nations; God sits on his holy what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 47:8 (ESV): "God reigns over the nations; God sits on his holy throne."

questions.question: The princes of the peoples gather as the people of the God of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 47:9 (ESV): "The princes of the peoples gather as the people of the God of Abraham."

questions.question: For the shields of the earth belong to whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 47:9 (ESV): "For the shields of the earth belong to God; he is highly exalted!"

questions.question: What instrument is mentioned in verse 5?
questions.explanation: Psalm 47:5 (ESV): "...the Lord with the sound of a trumpet."

questions.question: How many times is "Sing praises" repeated in verse 6?
questions.explanation: Psalm 47:6 (ESV): "Sing praises to God, sing praises! Sing praises to our King, sing praises!" (4 times).

questions.question: God is King of all the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 47:7 (ESV): "For God is the King of all the earth;"

questions.question: This Psalm is attributed to whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 47 Title: "To the choirmaster. A Psalm of the Sons of Korah."

key_verse_text: Clap your hands, all peoples! Shout to God with loud songs of joy!
